title: CLEF HIPE-2026: Evaluating Accurate and Efficient Person–Place Relation Extraction from Multilingual Historical Texts
reasoning: The paper describes a shared task and benchmark for person-place relation extraction in historical texts. While it uses terms like 'epistemically inconsistent' and 'Abductive interpretation' to define its data labeling logic and linguistic reasoning framework, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
